name: QRBatch — Batch QR Labels from CSV: Numbered, Print-Ready A4 Sheets at 300 DPI (Asset Tags & Inventory)
description:
I need QR codes for my asset tags, inventory labels and equipment stickers — how do I generate numbered, print-ready sheets in one batch? When every item needs its own code — labelled, in order, ready to print — online generators answer with a subscription, a per-code fee, or limits right where your print run starts.
QRBatch turns a CSV into numbered, print-ready QR labels on your own computer — and gives you a manifest so you can verify the whole run line by line before a single sheet is printed.
WHAT YOU GET FROM ONE CSV
• One labelled PNG per row (the label printed right under the code)
• A4 print sheets at 300 dpi, 12 codes per page, in a single PDF — straight to the printer
• A manifest CSV mapping every file to its label and payload, so you can check the print run item by item
• Error-correction level M — codes still scan with ~15% damage or dirt
HONEST DETAILS
• Duplicate payloads and empty rows are reported, not silently merged or dropped
• No watermarks, no dynamic-link middleman, no expiry: these are plain QR codes of YOUR links, generated offline
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
Seeded 5-row CSV with a duplicate and an empty row: 4 codes generated, both problems itemized in the report, print sheet and manifest produced.
100% LOCAL — no upload, no account, no per-code credits. Make ten codes or ten thousand for one payment.
Windows 10/11, nothing else to install. You provide a CSV with a link column (and optionally a label column).
